plan.name: Build each plan step as one change
plan.summary: A factory-authenticated step of a ratified plan of issues must draft one complete plumbing or modeled change, including when a writer requests /invariant plan, answers a fork or asks for a revision; identify membership from the matching factory record on the parent, not an issue-body marker alone, and keep that context separate from the ratifier's current write permission. Carry the parent issue into planner instructions and check-tool configuration, refuse issues.json in both agent checks and final draft validation even alongside another draft, and refuse a returned or recovered plan-of-issues result before posting it; when the step cannot fit, the planner asks a fork explaining what does not fit and suggesting replacement steps in the parent, offering either one complete change or a writer stopping the parent and requesting a replacement plan on a new top-level issue with /invariant plan. Ordinary issues retain plans of issues through both /invariant plan and plumbing planning, while already-ratified nested plans retain their hashes, ordered execution, completion checks and restart behavior. Update SPEC.md and docs/factory.md to describe the one-level limit, the question and replacement-plan workflow, and the exception for existing ratified nesting, citing the recorded grounds and this issue's ratified plan. The merger must record the new restriction refining D-0162, grounded in D-0105 and D-0147; the existing command-tool test only needs to supply the unrestricted parent context for its unchanged behavior.

tests.name: TestPlanStepRefusesFurtherIssuePlans560
tests.says: A recorded step refuses a planner's issues.json through initial drafting, /invariant plan and revision, with no nested proposal or opened issue; an ordinary issue, including a copied marker, can still propose a plan of issues.

tests.name: TestPlanStepCanAskThenProposeOneChange560
tests.says: Plumbing and modeled steps receive the single-change and oversized-step guidance, post their question, and can propose the complete single change after a writer answers, even through /invariant plan.

tests.name: TestExistingNestedPlansKeepWorking560
tests.says: Already-ratified nested plans still advance once under matching completion hashes across restarts, but their newly drafted leaves cannot create another plan of issues.

tests.name: TestStepDraftValidationAndPrompts560
tests.says: Caller-supplied parent context gives plumbing and modeled planners clear single-change guidance and follows them to the check process; final validation refuses issues.json without relying on an agent check, accepts forks, and leaves ordinary issue planning available.

tests.name: TestStepCheckToolsRefuseIssuePlans560
tests.says: All draft check tools refuse issues.json for a parented step, including mixed output, record the failure within the shared check allowance, and keep top-level plan-of-issues checks working.
